title: Growth config: LTV_POLICY
description: Cohort retention and LTV model settings (GRW-P3-C). Reporting only (AD-10). Nothing here can lower the k-anonymity floor: both minimums are at least 10. Added in 1.13.0. PROPOSED_DEFAULT until ratified. Unknown keys rejected.

horizonMonths.description: Months of contribution an LTV covers. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 12.

tailFitWindowMonths.description: Observed months the geometric tail decay is estimated from. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 6.

discountRateBp.description: Annual discount rate in basis points. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 0.

includeRewardCost.description: Subtract platform-funded reward redemptions from revenue.

includeCampaignCost.description: Show payback against blended CAC from approved spend.

minCohortPatients.description: k-anonymity floor for cells and estimates; never below 10.

minPatientsPerObservedMonth.description: Patients old enough to have a month before it is used; never below 10.
